description: Fiberweb (India) Limited manufactures and sells spunbond and melt-blown nonwoven fabrics from polypropylene in India. The company's products are used in hygiene, medical, agricultural, industrial, and packaging applications, serving end uses such as personal hygiene products, medical disposables, wipes, filtration media, agricultural crop and soil covers, automotive interiors, geotextiles, and technical textiles. It offers nonwoven fabrics for applications including baby diapers, feminine hygiene, adult incontinence, face masks, crop covers, weed protection, bumper covers, trunk carpets, underbody panels, hospital masks, industrial garments, curtains, upholstery, luggage, bedsheets, and geotextiles, as well as melt-blown nonwoven fabrics for medical fabrics, face masks, disposable gowns, drapes, sterilization wraps, oil absorbents, filtration of chemicals, oil, air, and liquids, sanitary products, and disposable industrial apparel. The company exports its products to the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, and the Gulf countries. The company was formerly known as PVD Plast Mould Industries Limited. Fiberweb (India) Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
